rca_of_the_issue: Previous blocker was React-Leaflet not updating Marker interactive on mounted target markers. The remount key change target-${id}-${pick|idle} forces markers to re-create when entering pick mode, so green target circles receive clicks instead of letting clicks fall through to pole popups. The approved tap-based reconnect flow now completes end to end.
